about.p1: With a background in Urban Planning and expertise as a GIS Developer, I combine the power of spatial data with modern web technologies. My goal is to transform complex geographical and urban data into clear, manageable, and interactive digital systems.
about.p2: I specialize in enterprise-level solutions, particularly in large-scale real estate portfolio management, urban regeneration feasibilities, and automation processes. I believe maps are not just visuals, but powerful decision support tools.

projects.title: Selected Works
projects.intro: These projects show the systems I have worked on and the types of problems I address. You can review the existing descriptions and interactive demos.
projects.contactText: We can review the details if you need a similar system or a custom solution.
projects.p1_desc: An enterprise Web-GIS platform that manages real estate portfolios, spatially analyzes property data, and digitalizes processes. Parcels, real estate, zoning status, planning decisions, and project inventories are made analyzable via dynamic layers. A scalable architecture managed by role-based authorization consolidates multi-company and public data into a single database hierarchy. The platform's UI includes modules for spatial analysis, geometric properties, zoning compliance, project development, financial indicators, and external system integration. Interactive dashboards and thematic analysis tools were developed over a map, time, and attribute-based decision support system. Digital transformation of complex data from Excel, PDF, and physical documents was successfully executed.
projects.p2_title: ArcGIS Experience Builder Custom Widget Architecture
projects.p2_desc: Custom widgets were designed and developed to optimize enterprise GIS workflows on ArcGIS Experience Builder. User experience was improved by a Hierarchical Layer Manager allowing browser-side freezing of temporary data layers. A Dynamic PDF Reporting module enables instant corporate-template reporting of map views and analysis charts. Analysis tools were built to generate dynamic parcel query links from coordinate data via TKGM integration. Various widget components were produced featuring layer management, group filtering, smart search engines, data export, and admin panels.
projects.p3_desc: Data integration and management processes were executed via Python and ArcPy automation scripts, strictly preserving spatial data integrity. Digital transformation operations were carried out by converting complex data from Excel, PDFs, and physical documents without altering original content or headers. Pandas was utilized for large dataset processing, integration into the geodatabase structure, and automation of repetitive data preparation pipelines.
projects.p4_title: Open Source Web-GIS & Custom Mapping Applications
projects.p4_desc: Open-source Web-GIS portals are coded and independent projects developed to enable browser-based spatial analysis of extensive Excel inventory data without commercial license dependencies. Interactive map experiences are designed using React-Leaflet and OpenLayers infrastructure, producing modern interfaces for portfolio systems and data analysis workflows. Developed as alternatives to commercial GIS software, these projects offer tailored solutions for browser-based spatial analysis and visualization needs.
